title: Additive constant-presheaf charts near each point of a finite set chart
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $G$ an abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $U$ an object of its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], $S$ a finite set in the next universe, and $e$ an isomorphism from the restriction to $U$ of the underlying set sheaf of $G$ to the constant sheaf with value $S$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For each underlying point $x$ of $U$, there exist an etale $V\to U$, a point $v$ of $V$ above $x$, a finite abelian group $M$, a set-sheaf isomorphism $e\prime:\underline{|M|}\to |G|_V$ on the localized small etale site at $V\to Y$, and a natural transformation of abelian presheaves $\alpha:\operatorname{const}(M)\to G_V$. After forgetting abelian structure, $\alpha$ equals the constant set presheaf sheafification unit [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] followed by the underlying presheaf map of $e\prime$. No nonemptiness or connectedness assumption is imposed.

source.place: Definition 03RU (definition-finite-locally-constant), abelian clauses; agent-formulated finite-operation refinement, steps 1--3 of lem-weil-pbc-finite-constant-abelian-refinement. Tag 03RU supplies definitions, not this refinement theorem; the argument is the recorded agent-formulated proof.

proof.text: Apply the proved finite-label-subgroup neighborhood theorem to obtain V, v above x, a set chart with the original labels S, and an injective label function t into the abelian sections over V whose range contains zero and is closed under sums and negatives.

Construct the actual subgroup H of these sections with carrier range(t). The injectivity of t gives a bijection q:S to H, whose inverse is determined uniquely by t. Transport the abelian group structure of H along q, and bundle the resulting carrier S as M. Its finiteness is exactly the original Finite S instance. The composite of q as an additive equivalence with the subgroup inclusion is an additive map eta whose underlying function is t.

Let beta be the constant set presheaf unit followed by the obtained set chart. Naturality along the unique arrow to the terminal object says that every component of beta is a restriction of t. Restriction maps of G and eta preserve zero and addition, so each component of beta is an additive map. Bundle those component functions as AddCommGrpCat morphisms; their naturality is exactly the naturality of beta after extensionality. The resulting alpha forgets definitionally to beta. Return V, v, M, the set chart and alpha with that equality.
